payload.notes: The Critic checked it against the GDD and sent it back: The combination of 'wide-set eyes' and 'thick bushy brows' constitutes exaggerated facial features, which breaks the rule against exaggerated features. (GDD: "The face. Every face gets the same cartoon treatment, with no exaggerated features."). Remove exaggerated facial features such as 'wide-set eyes' and 'thick bushy brows'; adjust the face to use only standard cartoon features with no exaggeration.
